title: Rivals in Israel Election Strike Tone of Triumph, but Outcome Is Far From Clear
summary_full: Addressing supporters after midnight, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot, who leads a bloc of opposition parties, both expressed confidence that they will lead Israel’s next government. Vote counting could take days.
